claims: Immunizations prevent 3.5 to 5 million deaths every year.
DTaP (diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis) is a childhood vaccine.
MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) is a childhood vaccine.
Hepatitis A & B are childhood vaccines.
Flu shot is an adult vaccine.
Specific schedules for children, adolescents, and adults are recommended by organizations like the CDC.
Soreness at the injection site is a common temporary side effect of vaccines.
Low-grade fever is a common temporary side effect of vaccines.
